source: Salem et al. (2026), Advertising Images Dataset for Visual Analysis, Mendeley Data v1, DOI 10.17632/32grwbk6rv.1
license_listing: CC BY 4.0 on publisher dataset page; original social-platform creative rights require care
annotation_basis: Single AI-assisted project-author interpretation of publisher-extracted CSV copy, with selected screenshot spot checks; no regex output consulted; no independent human annotator
state_rule: For assessable English copy, all unlisted cues are absent. Listed present and ambiguous cues override absent. Unassessable creatives are excluded from primary binary metrics.
